concern_summary: This concern deals with enhancing user interaction by managing focus behavior and layout changes within the composer interface, particularly with regards to user input and suggestions.
This concern addresses the management of focus within the composer, including the assignment of focus callbacks and ensuring proper focus handling based on user interaction and component states.

This concern encompasses all functionalities related to the message composer, which allows users to input and send messages, manage attachments, determine visibility, and handle interactions effectively.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing and updating the cursor position during text input, ensuring accurate reflection of text changes and allowing for proper editing behaviors.
This concern focuses on the availability and state management of the Full Composer based on user permissions and input area height, ensuring a seamless message composition experience.
This concern covers the calculation of the cursor's relative position in order to appropriately display popover menus and additional UI elements, ensuring their visual alignment and accessibility.
This concern is dedicated to the functionality of copying HTML content from the composer interface while preserving the correct selection for clipboard transfer.

This concern revolves around user experience during page loading issues, specifically handling error situations such as 'Page Not Found', providing user-friendly error messages, and options for page refresh or navigation to maintain engagement.
